title: Specification of a Subarray
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, $a,k,n,\mathrm{top}\in\mathbb{N}$, $l$ be a list of integers, and $U\in\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose $l$ has length $N$, its $j$th entry is $\mu(a+j)$ for each $j<N$, every entry has absolute value at most $U$, and $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$. If $k+n\le N$, then the list obtained by dropping the first $k$ entries of $l$ and taking the next $n$ entries has length $n$, records the values of $\mu$ starting at index $a+k$, has all entries bounded in absolute value by $U$, and satisfies $(a+k)+n\le\mathrm{top}$.
hypotheses_covered: The original list has length N
The list records μ on the interval starting at a
Every list entry has absolute value at most U
